questions.enonce_markdown:
The table shows the number of pieces of paper picked by students in a dirty classroom.

| Number of pieces of paper | 0 | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Number of students | 1 | 2 | 5 | 4 | 6 | 2 |

Find the probability that a student chosen at random picked 4 pieces of paper. *[4 marks for the whole question]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
Total number of students: $1+2+5+4+6+2=20$.

$6$ students picked $4$ pieces of paper.

$P(\text{4 pieces})=\dfrac{\text{number of favourable students}}{\text{total number of students}}=\dfrac{6}{20}=\dfrac{3}{10}$.

**Answer: $\dfrac{3}{10}$ (that is $0.3$).**
